author: Amanjeet Singh
question: How does German manufacturing respond to unexpected future-policy news after separating current-rate and outlook news?
contribution: A test of anticipatory monetary transmission with an independently observed financial response scale, broad-output and durability comparisons; not a new general theory or a pure forward-guidance-versus-QE decomposition.
prior_information: Original German durability-gap outcomes, published euro-area forward-policy results, workbook definitions and all four source-only financial diagnostics are known. No new manufacturing or broad-industry response to these factors has been fitted. This is an informed redesign, not blind registration.
normalisation_choice: One-year AAA sovereign yield impact matches the one-year horizon of the supplied normalised future-policy factor and describes future financing news beyond current Target and Delphic news. It was selected after source-only screening and before production fitting. Retain all four financial benchmarks and protect the selected scale through family confidence sets.
instrument: Source MP_Odyssean_1Y divided by 0.10 percentage points; positive supplied value is a higher one-year OIS contribution. QE-package news can be included.
primary_financial_indicator: Monthly sum of same-day close-to-close changes in one-year AAA euro-area government zero-coupon spot yield, divided by 0.10 percentage points
financial_companions: one-year less three-month AAA yield slope
forward yield for months four to twelve: (one-year yield-.25*three-month yield)/.75
date_rules: Use cached workbook dates without refreshing external links. Verify four no-decision months as zeros inside coverage. Covered meetings with missing current or preceding curve values remain unavailable. August/September 2004 benchmarks are missing, not zero. Use common paired business dates, including the 1 May 2013 holiday exception.
controls: lags 1,2 of manufacturing monthly log growth
lags 1,2 of annual German HICP log inflation
lags 1,2 of each of the three normalised factors/0.10
lags 1,2 of both one-year and three-month announcement-day AAA yield changes/0.10
controls_rationale: Two lags give a compact state history comparable to the published supplementary local-projection check. Production is SCA and inflation annual, so no additional month dummies. Both yield histories keep the conditioning set identical across the four financial normalisations.
estimator: Just-identified LP-IV. Fit response and each financial indicator on the same excluded proxy and controls; use the reduced-form/first-stage ratio. It is a total future-policy shock response scaled to its 10 bp financial impact, not an intervention on the sovereign yield.
primary_inference: Calendar-HAC Anderson-Rubin inversion. For each candidate response theta and financial indicator x/0.10, test the excluded-proxy coefficient in Y-theta*x. Retain bounded, disconnected, unbounded, whole-line, point and empty confidence sets. For each outcome, invert all four restrictions at alpha=.05/4, giving at least 95%family coverage and protecting the selected normalisation under maintained score conditions.
companion_inference: Individual 95%AR sets and conventional delta intervals are diagnostics. No family claim across outcome/horizon families. The four-normalisation95%family protection is applied separately to each reported outcome.
covariance: Joint reduced-form and financial first-stage score covariance, each regression own residual, common calendar Bartlett kernel and one n/(n-k_augmented) multiplier; bandwidth h+ceil(4*(n/100)^(2/9)); no prewhitening.
first_stage: Report coefficient, covariance, conditional partial R2, leverage and HAC squared t on the same macro origins/controls; no iid F > 10 certification. A source-only fit is not the macro first stage.
assumptions: Conditional proxy relevance; contemporaneous and required lead/lag exclusion from other innovations; stable structural response; sufficient conditioning and valid weakly dependent score/HAC limits. Source signs and predictability checks do not prove exclusion. Supplied median factors treated as retained inputs; unobserved accepted-set/generated-factor uncertainty not recovered.
declared_outcomes: durable-minus-nondurable consumer-goods production heterogeneity, retained original official MIG definitions
sample_for_profiles: Same 2005-01–2016-01 origins for all horizons, no horizon or outcome selected by rejection.
sensitivity: three lags on the same origins and definitions
shorter and longer calendar bandwidths h+ceil(B/2) and h+2B on unchanged coefficients
falsification: Primary manufacturing growth from t-13 to t-1, regressed on the excluded proxy and identical controls; nominal 5%diagnostic, not proof of exclusion.
influence: Retain every primary origin. Report single-origin deletion reduced-form, first-stage and ratio ranges, including all unbounded or denominator-zero cases; no automatic exclusions.
reporting: British English, six main sections at most, concise essential methods, economic reasoning before algebra; appendix before references; 20-page maximum including references. No readiness claim from computation alone.
